question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Anaka Alankamony?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Squash**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anaka Alankamony** is a professional **squash player** from India.
 
• She has represented India in various international squash championships.
 
• Anaka has achieved significant success in her career, including winning medals in events like the Asian Junior Squash Championships.
 
• She is known for her agility, strategic gameplay, and contributions to popularizing squash in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Squash is a high-intensity racquet sport played by two players (singles) or four players (doubles) in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.
 
• The game requires excellent **hand-eye coordination, agility, and strategic shot placement**.
 
• Squash is governed by the **World Squash Federation (WSF)** and is played in over **185 countries** worldwide.
 
• India has produced several top squash players who have performed admirably in international competitions, contributing to the growth and popularity of the sport in the country.
